text: (1)Foreign citizens holding foreign passports;(2) The physical health condition meets the physical examination requirements stipulated bythe country and our school;(3) Age not exceeding 45 years old.(4)Having a bachelor's degree or equivalent education;(5) Non native English speaking applicants must achieve an English proficiency level of IELTS6.0 or TOEFL 75. Applicants without an English proficiency certificate are required to providea 3-minute English language video;(6)Students are required to undergo an interview organized by the school during theapplication process (which can be done remotely).
